#!/bin/bash
d=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$d" | grep -oP '"command"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]*'); if [ -n "$INFRA_MUTATION_OK" ] || echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'INFRA_MUTATION_OK=1'; then exit 0; fi; echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: terraform/tofu apply and destroy are state-mutating commands requiring explicit user confirmation' >&2; echo '[Hook] Run "terraform plan" (or "tofu plan") first and share the plan output for confirmation' >&2; echo '[Hook] After the user confirms, re-run the command prefixed with INFRA_MUTATION_OK=1' >&2; exit 2
